nodes.label: cfgeconomycore.xml
nodes.rationale: Register custom CE files separately so mod additions remain reviewable and survive vanilla mission updates.

nodes.label: count_in_hoarder
nodes.rationale: Counting stashed high-value items makes hoarding suppress replenishment instead of multiplying rare loot.

nodes.label: Backup Strategy
nodes.rationale: Stop the server before copying persistence; keep multiple generations off-machine so mid-save corruption and disk failure do not destroy every copy.

nodes.label: Idle Mode
nodes.rationale: Pause economy work when the server is empty to avoid unnecessary spawn cycles.

nodes.label: servermod
nodes.rationale: Keep server-only logic in -servermod when clients require no assets or scripts from the package.

Setting enableCfgGameplayFile to one enables mission gameplay tuning.
Night speed multiplies the general time acceleration.

Respawn targets interact with minimum population and replacement cooldown.

World and binary character state are reconstructed from storage on restart.

Player proximity delays cleanup beyond an expired lifetime.
Full, character, and object wipes target distinct persistence folders.
Damage immunity does not prevent territory decay.

Active dynamic events add spawn cleanup cycles and tracked entities.

Smaller activation distance reduces simultaneously active infected zones.

Persistence bloat increases save I/O and can cause hitching.

Public keys establish trust for mod signatures checked at connection.

Restart examples force-stop or signal processes and back up a profile storage path, while canonical persistence guidance requires a confirmed graceful stop and mission storage path; reconcile before reuse.
This chapter claims launch-line order controls dependencies, conflicting with the config.cpp reference that specifies requiredAddons dependency sorting.
RCON example uses port 2305 while server setup uses 2305 for Steam queries; source also requires the two ports not collide.
Directory listing calls bans Steam64 IDs, while the Access Control chapter specifies 44-character DayZ UIDs.
